verdict.rationale: cubic documents custom agents as review rules that enforce an organization's practices across pull requests (cubic-docs-9, cubic-docs-22). They are configured in cubic.yaml (cubic-docs-11, cubic-docs-34), can be adopted from a community library (cubic-docs-30), and run as part of the automatic review of every new PR (cubic-docs-1, cubic-docs-47). A community comment independently confirms the rules are plain-English text kept in the codebase (cubic-comm-2); its skepticism about determinism is not a hands-on failure. Missing for 10: evidence that custom-agent findings act as blocking pass/fail merge checks or status gates, documented examples of checks like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths', and in-depth docs on rule authoring syntax.
